name: Grand Traverse County, MI
findings: Grand Traverse County has 481 nonprofit organizations. 193 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 149 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Grand Traverse County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Grand Traverse County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 professional organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.
